en.headline: 3 commits, 4 issue actions, 1 discussion reply on 2026-10-15
en.summary: On 2026-10-15, `sogeisetsu` recorded **3 own commits** across two repositories, plus 19 additional automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, the two own commits updated the daily-report agent docs to explain commit-attribution aliases and fixed the daily script so commit attribution supports aliases and non-GitHub-account emails. In `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`, a single chore commit tagged the release as `v1.15.5`. No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded. Issue activity totaled 4 actions, all in `openchamber/openchamber`: opened issue `#4920` about the context panel breakdown bar dividing whole-session estimates by the last message's input so 其他 is always 0%, closed issue `#4346` about `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` still passing after `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` were removed in `d9fbf6b`, commented on that same `#4346`, and commented on issue `#4111` about deleting a multi-run leaving orphaned MCP child processes that make `git worktree remove --force` fail with Permission denied. The user also joined an existing discussion, `#4821` titled "[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel" in `openchamber/openchamber`, which currently has 1 comment. No truncation flags were hit in any section.

zh.headline: 2026-10-15：3 次提交、4 次 issue 操作、1 条讨论回复
zh.summary: 2026-10-15，`sogeisetsu` 在两个仓库中共完成 **3 次本人提交**，另有 19 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，两次本人提交分别更新了 daily-report agent 文档以说明提交归属别名，并修复了 daily 脚本，使提交归属支持别名并兼容非 GitHub 账号邮箱的提交。在 `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 中，一次 chore 提交将版本标记为 `v1.15.5`。当日没有 PR、review 或 release 记录。Issue 活动共 4 次操作，全部发生在 `openchamber/openchamber`：新开 issue `#4920`，指出上下文面板的 breakdown bar 用最后一条消息的 input 去除整段会话的估算值，导致“其他”始终为 0%；关闭 issue `#4346`，该 issue 反映 `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` 在 `d9fbf6b` 移除 `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` 后仍然通过；在同一 `#4346` 上留言；并在 issue `#4111` 上留言，该 issue 描述删除 multi-run 会留下孤立的 MCP 子进程，导致 `git worktree remove --force` 因 Permission denied 失败。用户还参与了一条已有讨论，即 `openchamber/openchamber` 中 `#4821` “[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel”，该讨论目前共有 1 条评论。所有分段的截断标记均未触发。
